title: What post-training changed inside Qwen 3.5 2B
question: Where in the network do the base and instruct models part ways, and can one vector move the base model toward the instruct one?

summary.headline: biggest change at layer 21 (50%); one shift vector closes 4% of the KL gap

claims.text: Post-training moves the residual stream most around layer 21: the median token's state differs from the base model's by 50% of its size there.
claims.test: descriptive: measured on every token of these prompts

claims.text: Adding one vector, the average tuned-minus-base shift at layer 23 (dose 0.5), to the base model closes 4% of the next-token KL gap to the tuned model (95% CI -17% to 8%); a random vector of the same size closes -6%.
claims.test: CI lower bound beats the random vector by 5 points; per-prompt KL ratios, bootstrapped
